name: Nemesszalók (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nemesszalók: a crowned red shield with a white swan and a ploughshare on a green mound, above a scroll inscribed NEMESSZALÓK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nemesszalók arms with crown and scroll
